lunorash.description: Unscoped umbrella — one install for the base packages (server, values, runtime, do, client) via subpaths, plus the lunora CLI bin.

server.description: Authoring API: defineSchema, defineTable, query, mutation, action.

runtime.description: Worker entry: RPC router, shard resolver, query coordinator.

do.description: ShardDO (SQLite, OCC, hibernated WebSocket subscriptions) and SessionDO.

d1.description: D1 adapter for .global() tables; wraps the Sessions API for read-your-writes.

client.description: Browser SDK: WebSocket transport, optimistic updates, offline queue.

vue.description: Live composables, optimistic mutations, reactive loaders.

solid.description: Live queries, optimistic mutations, reactive loaders for SolidJS.

svelte.description: Live stores, optimistic mutations, reactive loaders.

db.description: defineCollections wires Lunora queries/mutations into live, indexed client collections + a durable offline outbox.

studio.description: Local admin UI for your schema, data, logs, and advisors.

vite.description: Vite plugin over @cloudflare/vite-plugin — codegen, wrangler validator, error overlay.

astro.description: Astro integration: single-worker composition plus reactive-loader server helpers.

cli.description: Subcommands: init, dev, deploy, codegen, run, reset, migrate.

config.description: Shared CLI + Vite config/scaffolding layer (wrangler validator, .dev.vars grammar).

testing.description: In-memory harness for queries/mutations/actions plus E2E mail-catcher helpers.

advisor.description: Schema & query lints (splinter-style advisors) feeding the Studio Advisors table.

ai.description: Workers AI helper on the Vercel AI SDK — ctx.ai with generateText / streamText / embed.
features: Workers AI on the Vercel AI SDK

analytics.description: Analytics Engine bindings for usage and event metrics.

auth.description: Auth built on better-auth, D1-backed: email/password, OAuth, passkeys, 2FA, organizations.

browser.description: Browser Rendering — Playwright on Cloudflare Workers.

container.description: Cloudflare Containers: defineContainer → generated container DOs + typed ctx.containers.

hyperdrive.description: Connect an external Postgres/MySQL database via Cloudflare Hyperdrive (ctx.sql).

images.description: Cloudflare Images transforms and typed delivery.

mail.description: Resend adapter, TSX templates, queue-backed sends.

mcp.description: Model Context Protocol server exposing a Lunora deployment to AI agents.

payment.description: Payment provider integration (Stripe) with typed actions and webhooks.

ratelimit.description: Token-bucket / fixed-window / sliding-window limiting with pluggable stores and middleware.

scheduler.description: runAfter / runAt plus Cron Triggers via SchedulerDO.

seed.description: Snaplet-style deterministic seeding introspected from defineSchema.

storage.description: R2 typed buckets and signed URLs.

vectors.description: Cloudflare Vectorize adapter: typed vector indexes and similarity search.

workflow.description: Durable, multi-step workflows wired into the worker entry.
